title: PAGODA 50-DAY — Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: PAGODA 50-DAY is listed as 57 km with 3,600 m of elevation gain, starting on Saturday 28 November 2026 at 07:00 from Doi Inthanon National Park HQ, with a maximum allowed race time of 16 hours 30 minutes.
The race carries 4 Running Stones and the page labels its finals access as '50k-direct-entry-major'.

The course is a loop that starts and finishes at the Doi Inthanon National Park Headquarters and passes Doi Hua Suea, Doi Pha Tang Peak and the Twin Royal Pagodas before reaching the summit of Doi Inthanon.
The aid stations are B1 Mae Klang Luang School, B2 Pha Tang Junction, B3 Mae Uam Water Resource Management Office, B4 Mae Chaem Guard Unit and B5 Relic of the Buddha.
The published time chart gives cumulative distances of 8.3 km (B1), 19.6 km (B2), 28.7 km (B3), 40.1 km (B4), 47.6 km (B5) and 56.7 km (finish).
The published time chart gives cut-off times of 15:00 at B3, 18:00 at B4, 21:30 at B5 and 23:30 at the finish, while no cut-off times are shown for B1 and B2.
The page states that the PAGODA 50 route is 57 km even though the race is named PAGODA 50.
